note: Real elevation windows used as valleys by geo.py. Heights in metres, north up, 192x144 cells. The sea is not taken from the data (it is unreliable there): geo.py lets the sea in from the south edge to a level of its own choosing, drowning the valley's mouth.
source: Terrain Tiles (Mapzen terrarium), AWS Open Data: https://registry.opendata.aws/terrain-tiles/
attribution: Elevation data: Mapzen Terrain Tiles and their sources (SRTM, EU-DEM, ArcticDEM and others); see https://github.com/tilezen/joerd/blob/master/docs/attribution.md

glen_brittle.name: Glen Brittle（苏格兰斯凯岛）
glen_brittle.about: 三面是山、向南开口入海的冰蚀谷：宽平的谷底，陡峭的谷壁，河在谷底蜿蜒入海湾。

glen_etive.name: Glen Etive（苏格兰）
glen_etive.about: 长而深的冰蚀谷，河注入狭长的海湾。

samaria.name: Samaria 峡谷出海口（克里特岛）
samaria.about: 夏干气候下深切的峡谷，出口是卵石滩，几乎没有平地。

hornvik.name: Hornvík（冰岛）
hornvik.about: 亚寒带的冰蚀谷湾：谷底平而湿，两侧是崖。
